QuestInfo.name: Beasts on Parade
QuestInfo.0: You can't just turn your back on those in need. Help them repair their broken fence.
QuestInfo.1: It's said that Stump Spooks are made of old, sturdy wood. Defeat Stump Spooks and collect #t4036713:#.
QuestInfo.2:

default.0: You can obtain #t4036713:# by defeating the Stump Spooks that appear in #m875001106#. I'll stay and lend an ear to the people. Hurry on back!
